regime_read: Today's pack shows a crowded mega-cap AI complex (MSFT, NVDA, META, GOOGL) with broad affiliation and analyst-bull convergence but weak relative strength — smart-money channels are present, yet no endorsement from price. The cleanest independent alignment is outside the AI trade: T shows genuine multi-channel policy accumulation (congress cluster + government-contract acceleration + lobbying), and AVOID flags on RSG's Trump-sell plus LUV's thin activist read.
regime_read_zh: 今日证据包显示超大盘AI板块（MSFT、NVDA、META、GOOGL）出现广泛关联与分析师看多共振，但相对强弱疲弱——聪明钱通道存在，却无价格背书。最干净的独立共振出现在AI交易之外：T表现出真正的多通道政策性积累（国会集群+政府合约加速+游说），RSG的Trump卖出信号与LUV薄弱的激进投资者信号则应规避。

theses.thesis: T is the one name in the pack where independent channels genuinely align: a congress_cluster of 4 members with net +7 positions [congress_cluster], a 41.69% government-contract acceleration [gov_contract_accel], and $3.5M lobbying spend [lobbying] all point the same policy-first direction. The stock is NOT extended (rs_vs_spy_60d = -4.0), so the entry is not gone. This is a policy/regulatory convergence, not a growth story — appropriate for a medium-to-long horizon read.
theses.thesis_zh: T是整个证据包中唯一独立通道真正共振的标的：4名国会议员的国会集群[通道:congress_cluster]持净+7头寸，政府合约41.69%的加速[通道:gov_contract_accel]，以及350万美元的游说支出[通道:lobbying]均指向同一政策优先方向。该股并不过热（60日相对SPY为-4.0），因此入场窗口尚未关闭。这是政策/监管层面的收敛，而非成长故事——适合中长期维度的判断。
second_order: VZ: T的政策利好受益同样映射到通信业对手方，二者共享行业监管脉络
TMUS: 若T的政府合约加速源于基建/5G项目，TMUS作为同行也可能享有类似的行业尾风
通信基础设施ETF/主题: T的合约加速暗示更广泛的电信基础设施资本开支周期
theses.dissent: The convergence is entirely policy-channel based — no fundamental demand signal (no app_demand, no patent_cluster, no analyst_upgrade_cluster). Congressional positions are disclosed with lag and may reflect a mean-reversion bet, not forward information.

falsifier.text: T breaks below its 60-day relative-SPY low on volume with no new contract announcement

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: MU shows a dense cluster of flow-based signals: insider MSPR at 100 [insider_mspr], a perfect analyst bull ratio of 1.0 [analyst_upgrade_cluster], StockTwits bull ratio of 1.0 with 213K watchers [stocktwits_bull], and 288 new patents [patent_cluster]. The political tie via Ro Khanna [actor:Ro Khanna] adds a policy-darling angle. However, at rs_vs_spy_60d = +19.8 the name is already extended — the easy entry is gone. WATCH for a pullback toward relative strength before considering any position.
theses.thesis_zh: MU表现出密集的流量型信号共振：内部人MSPR达100[通道:insider_mspr]，分析师看多比率为满分1.0[通道:analyst_upgrade_cluster]，StockTwits看多比率为1.0且拥有21.3万关注者[通道:stocktwits_bull]，另有288项新专利[通道:patent_cluster]。罗·卡纳议员[actor:Ro Khanna]的政治关联更增添其政策宠儿色彩。然而60日相对SPY为+19.8，该股已然过热——轻松的入场点已经消失。应等待其相对强弱回撤至可入场水平再作考虑。
second_order: WDC: 同为存储芯片制造商，MU的供需改善会传导到竞争者
SMH/半导体ETF: MU的专利+分析师共振是更广泛半导体周期的领先指标
AI基础设施主题: MU的HBM产能若被验证，受益方是整个AI算力链
theses.dissent: The signal cluster is almost entirely flow/positioning based — insider MSPR, analyst upgrades, and StockTwits sentiment are all momentum proxies. With rs_vs_spy_60d at +19.8, the market has already priced the bullish story. The patent channel may be noise from prior R&D spending, not forward commercial success.

falsifier.text: MU loses its relative-strength premium and closes back below +5pp vs SPY on 60d

theses.thesis: MSFT has the widest channel footprint of the pack (6 channels, convergence_score=6 [weighted convergence]): strong app_demand with 21.3M reviews and 4.77 rating, 318 patents [patent_cluster], 33.7M HF model downloads [hf_model_momentum], and a $3.65M lobbying presence [lobbying]. The Sam Altman partnership [actor:Sam Altman, PARTNERS_WITH, FACT] is the most consequential tie — it links MSFT to the OpenAI compute cycle. At rs_vs_spy_60d=+11.3 the name is not extended but has already absorbed the AI enthusiasm. WATCH for an entry on a pullback.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT拥有本证据包中最广泛的通道覆盖（6个通道，收敛分6分）：强劲的应用需求（2130万条评论、4.77评分），318项专利[通道:patent_cluster]，3370万次HF模型下载[通道:hf_model_momentum]，以及365万美元的游说投入[通道:lobbying]。山姆·奥特曼的合作伙伴关系[actor:Sam Altman, PARTNERS_WITH, FACT]是最具分量的关联——它将MSFT与OpenAI的算力周期直接绑定。60日相对SPY为+11.3，该股尚未过热，但AI热情已被充分消化。应等待回撤后寻找入场时机。
second_order: OpenAI供应链上的上市标的: MSFT与OpenAI的合作关系向上游算力、服务器硬件传导
AVGO/网络设备: MSFT的资本开支若加速，网络与定制ASIC供应商受益
英伟达NVDA: MSFT的算力扩张是NVDA最重要的需求来源之一
theses.dissent: The Altman partnership is FACT but the direction is ambiguous — it also signals OpenAI may be diversifying compute partners away from MSFT. The broad channel count reflects MSFT's sheer size, not necessarily unusual activity; every mega-cap scores high on absolute metrics.

falsifier.text: MSFT's HF model downloads decelerate 30d-over-30d while its app-store rating rolls over

theses.thesis: RSG is a conflicting-signal case: a large insider buying cluster (19 buyers, $262.7M net [insider_cluster]) conflicts directly with a Trump-channel sell signal [trump: side='sell']. The Trump actor network has been the single most predictive component of this desk's alt-data history, and when it diverges from other channels, the trump signal has historically been the one that matters. The insider cluster may be routine option exercise or estate planning, not directional accumulation. AVOID until the divergence resolves.
theses.thesis_zh: RSG属于信号冲突型标的：大规模内部人买入集群（19名买家，净买入2.627亿美元[通道:insider_cluster]）与Trump通道的卖出信号[通道:trump: side='sell']直接对立。Trump行为者网络是本团队另类数据史上预测力最强的单一组件，当其与其他通道背离时，Trump信号历来都是最关键的一方。内部人集群可能是常规的期权行权或是资产规划，而非方向性累积。在背离消解之前应予以规避。
second_order: WM/废物管理同行: 若RSG的内部人行为实为资产配置而非基本面，行业逻辑同样受影响
WCN: 同为废弃物服务商，若RSG出现定价压力，其竞争对手可能同样承压
theses.dissent: The insider cluster is one of the largest in the pack (19 distinct buyers, $262.7M) — it could be genuine informed accumulation. The Trump sell signal is binary and may reflect a hedge unwinding, not a directional short.

falsifier.text: RSG posts an outsized positive earnings surprise and the Trump channel flips to buy

theses.thesis: LUV shows a rare four-channel alignment: an activist 13D filing [activist_13d], a Trump buy signal [trump: side='buy'], strong app demand (4.84 rating, 7.2M reviews [app_demand]), and Paul Singer's affiliation [actor:Paul Singer, AFFILIATES_WITH, DISCLOSED]. The activist + Trump combination is particularly interesting as independent channels rarely converge on a mid-cap name. However, the signal is thin in magnitude (weighted_score=1.6, convergence_score=4) and the stock is only +1.1 vs SPY — the market has not yet confirmed the read. WATCH for confirmation.
theses.thesis_zh: LUV呈现出罕见的四通道共振：激进投资者13D备案[通道:activist_13d]，Trump买入信号[通道:trump: side='buy']，强劲的应用需求（4.84评分、720万条评论[通道:app_demand]），以及保罗·辛格的关联[actor:Paul Singer, AFFILIATES_WITH, DISCLOSED]。激进投资者 + Trump的组合尤为值得关注，因为独立通道很少在中小盘股名上收敛。然而信号强度偏弱（加权分1.6，收敛分4），且该股仅领先SPY +1.1——市场尚未确认这一判断。应等待确认。
second_order: UAL/DAL: 若LUV的激进投资者逻辑是行业性成本削减，同行同样受益
航空业ETF: 13D备案往往预示着行业性的股东行动浪潮
theses.dissent: App-store ratings are a weak fundamental signal for airlines — a 4.84 rating reflects existing customer satisfaction, not forward bookings. The Paul Singer affiliation is qualitative and DISCLOSED, not a fresh 13D. The activist angle may already be fully priced.

falsifier.text: LUV's app-store review velocity drops 30d-over-30d while the 13D holder reports no change in stake

theses.thesis: GOOGL shows a meaningful pullback (rs_vs_spy_60d = -14.8) against a backdrop of persistent smart-money positioning: Nancy Pelosi holds a disclosed stake [actor:Nancy Pelosi, HOLDS_STAKE, DISCLOSED], 273.7M HF downloads [hf_model_momentum], a 4.71 app rating with 26.2M reviews [app_demand], and $4.81M lobbying [lobbying]. The -14.8 relative weakness makes this a potential contrarian entry if the smart-money channels are forward-looking. However, congressional disclosures lag and a -14.8 drawdown can deepen. WATCH, do not preempt.
theses.thesis_zh: GOOGL出现了显著的相对回撤（60日相对SPY为-14.8），但其背后的聪明钱持仓持续存在：南希·佩洛西持有已披露的股份[actor:Nancy Pelosi, HOLDS_STAKE, DISCLOSED]，2.737亿次HF下载[通道:hf_model_momentum]，4.71的应用评分及2620万条评论[通道:app_demand]，以及481万美元的游说投入[通道:lobbying]。-14.8的相对弱势使其成为可能的逆势入场候选，前提是聪明钱通道确具前瞻性。然而国会披露存在滞后，且-14.8的回撤可能进一步加深。应密切观察，而非抢跑入场。
second_order: Google Cloud的AI客户: GOOGL的HF下载量激增暗示其云AI采用加速
数字广告同行META: 若GOOGL的弱势源于行业性广告定价压力，META或同样受波及
theses.dissent: The -14.8 relative drawdown is telling us something — the market is selling GOOGL for a reason the alt-data channels haven't yet captured. The Pelosi stake is disclosed with delay and may already be stale. HF downloads could reflect enterprise adoption without monetization.

falsifier.text: GOOGL breaks below its relative-SPY support from the last 60 days without any new alt-data signal

theses.thesis: BRK.B draws three channels — a 13F add [13f_add], Warren Buffett's CONTROLS relationship [actor:Warren Buffett, CONTROLS, FACT], and a congress cluster of 4 members with net +11 [congress_cluster]. However, BRK.B is flagged scorable=false and the 13F add is a portfolio allocation by other funds into Berkshire, not Berkshire buying back its own stock. The Buffett control signal is trivial (he always controls Berkshire). The congress buying is modest ($60.5M position). This is a weak read.
theses.thesis_zh: BRK.B汇集了三条通道——13F新增持仓[通道:13f_add]，沃伦·巴菲特的CONTROLS关系[actor:Warren Buffett, CONTROLS, FACT]，以及4名国会议员的净+11头寸的国会集群[通道:congress_cluster]。然而，BRK.B被标记为scorable=false，且13F新增持仓是其他基金对伯克希尔的组合配置，并非伯克希尔回购自身股票。巴菲特的控制信号是平凡的（他一直控制伯克希尔）。国会持仓规模适中（6050万美元）。这是一个较弱的判断。
second_order: 金融/保险主题: BRK.B的保险和金融子公司是其盈利核心
theses.dissent: The convergence is essentially non-informative — every component is either trivial (Buffett controls Berkshire), lagged (13F disclosure), or modest (congress position). No forward-looking channel supports the read.

falsifier.text: No new 13F filings show continued accumulation into BRK.B next quarter

track_record.calibration_note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.
track_record.calibration_note_zh: 尚无判断被评分 —— 待首批核查日到期后开始累积战绩；在此之前置信保持克制。
track_record.note: Alt-data brain theses graded vs SPY. The actionable axis is calibrated by this track record; conviction defers to it.
